transitions.evidence: The montage introduced at u1428-u1430 covers the available day before the ritual; u1483 looks back at sleeping the previous night, and u1539 calls the ritual the following evening. transitions.label: After sunset: mourning and funeral
transitions.evidence: u2747 describes the cloisters in darkness because the sun has set; u2756-u2758 have the party settle for the evening and the funeral, leaving next steps for morning. The source does not advance into that morning.
